text: 新疆维吾尔自治区公布2026年前三季度国民经济运行情况数据，根据地区生产总值统一核算结果，2026年前三季度，新疆地区生产总值16430.63亿元，按不变价格计算，同比增长4.2%，低于同期全国水平（4.6%），快于新疆上半年GDP增速（3.7%）。（澎湃）
text_en: The Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region released data on its national economic performance for the first three quarters of 2026. According to the unified regional GDP accounting results, in the first three quarters of 2026, Xinjiang's GDP was 1,643.063 billion yuan, up 4.2% year on year at constant prices, lower than the national level of 4.6% for the same period and faster than Xinjiang's GDP growth of 3.7% in the first half of the year. (The Paper)
